fieldValues.statement: Review at the source over review at deployment
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless the deployment also changes code or configuration: then that change is reviewed where it is made.
fieldValues.context: A pin bump that only selects an already-merged or released commit merges on green checks (d529294a, proposed). The opposite pole from the commands layer on the same tension: the two layers differ, so this is a boundary, not a conflict.
